fields.label: Route Name
fields.description: The business key, and what appears on an application. The three shipped rows are named exactly as the superseded Select's options were - 'Government Quota', 'Management Quota', 'Direct' - so the field becomes a Link with no data migration, the same move slice 3 made for Institution Type

fields.label: Requires Allotment
fields.description: Whether a seat on this route is decided by an external counselling body, so the pipeline must see an allotment before admitting. A Check rather than a Select because this does not cascade - a route inherits nothing from another route, so there is no third state to distinguish. Replaces the GOVERNMENT_QUOTA literal the allotment gate used to compare against

fields.label: Is Standard
fields.description: Shipped with the app. A standard route cannot be deleted - the allotment gate resolves through it, and a deleted row would leave every application on that route unsaveable

fields.label: Standard Key
fields.description: The name this row shipped under. `route_name` is the primary key and may be relabelled, so it cannot also be what the seed recognises a shipped row by
